items.title: How one hedge-fund manager built his firm to be powered entirely by AI agents
items.summary: Hedge-fund manager Brian Kelly has his staff working 24/7, yet his payroll costs are a fraction of what they once were.

items.title: Visa tells CNBC it is expanding data offering for blockchain lenders as demand for stablecoin-linked cards surges
items.summary: Visa said Tuesday morning it will make more data available to companies lending on the blockchain as stablecoin-linked cards are met with strong demand.

items.title: Crypto platforms have lost over $3.63 billion to cyberattacks — even though most of them did security checks
items.summary: Security audits weren't enough to keep many cryptocurrency platforms safe from money-losing hacks, crypto market data site CoinGecko said in a report dated Aug. 27 .

items.title: White House has vetted candidates for key CFTC vacancies, sources tell CNBC. It's unclear if they will be filled
items.summary: The White House has vetted candidates for the four open commissioner positions at the Commodity Futures Trading Commission , three people with knowledge of the matter told CNBC.

items.title: China says it will pump $54 billion into banks and insurers — but their stocks still fell
items.summary: China's finance ministry is leading a smaller-than-expected $54 billion capital injection into state-owned banks and insurers, as Beijing seeks to foster growth with restrained stimulus.

items.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs worth CA$27.6 billion take effect as trade rift with U.S. deepens
items.summary: Canada's retaliatory tariffs on a wide array of U.S. goods took effect Tuesday, further escalating a feud between Washington and Ottawa that had already boiled over after trade talks collapsed last month.

items.title: China's imports in August miss estimates as calls for rebalancing trade grow
items.summary: China's trade growth picked up in August, though imports missed expectations, a sign that domestic demand remains tepid as the world's second-largest economy faces mounting pressure to rebalance trade.

items.title: Japan's foreign reserves drop by a record $80 billion in August following yen intervention
items.summary: Japan's foreign reserves have fallen at their fastest pace since ministry records started in 2000, slumping 6.18% in August.
